cases.title: Scheduled imports leave valid orders in review
cases.task: Diagnose why partner batch 41 leaves visually valid orders in review after scheduled import. The same orders pass after an administrator re-enters the visible region value.
cases.expected_systemic_cause: Order entry paths do not share one canonical region-code boundary.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Confirm H101 and increase its context score by 5 while keeping its rank at or below 3.
scoring.information_gap: The visible incident does not include the prior administrator-path defect or the repository pattern that connects both entry paths.
scoring.plausible_local_correction: Trim or remap the region value only in the scheduled importer.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Confirm H102 and increase its context score by 5 while keeping its rank at or below 3.

cases.title: Restored account has conflicting export state
cases.task: Diagnose why a restored account shows export access in the dashboard while the export API continues to return a forbidden response.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Confirm H103 and increase its context score by 5 while keeping its rank at or below 3.

scoring.plausible_local_correction: Invalidate the API cache after account restoration.

cases.title: Rapid branch switch leaves clients disagreeing

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Confirm H104 and increase its context score by 5 while keeping its rank at or below 3.
